related_questions.question: What is the difference between a CPA and a tax pro?
related_questions.snippet: A CPA is a full-service financial professional who is generally better suited to provide year-round accounting services and tax planning. A tax preparer is someone who is licensed to prepare and file taxes, and is generally the right choice for someone who specifically needs help when it comes time to file.
